text:
anita: prepping a staggered v2 exposure for tomorrow. proposal: opt-in header + tenant safeguard. change window 01:30-04:00 UTC. start small (5% opt-in traffic) then evaluate.

ryan: make sure tenant pinlist prevents any automatic opt-in for enterprise. we can't have legal customers accidentally switched.

anita: yes 100% 90-day enterprise pins will remain. we'll read from /admin/pinlist and honor x-tenant-pin.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by anita at 01:30 UTC
deploy-bot: run: `redwoodctl deploy --env=prod --route=/api/v2 --mode=opt-in --header=x-api-v=2 --tag=optin-4087`

sdk-team: note: Android SDK normalizes header case; recommend `x-api-version` lower-case to avoid mismatch.

anita: thanks. using `x-api-version: v2-optin` instead. infra, add routing rule to prefer header when present but do NOT override tenant pins.

infra: added rule `header_prefer_v2` with precedence below tenant_pin. TTL 8h.

oncall: alert rules set: page on prod_5xx_rate increase >=0.4% over baseline for 5m OR auth_denied_by_proxy spikes >10 in 2m.

ryan: let's also whitelist a canary tenant group (canary-1) for full v2 opt-in tests. they have automated smoke suite.

anita: adding canary tenants: canary-1, canary-2. will remove after 12h.

deploy-bot: opt-in gate enabled at 01:35 UTC, header=`x-api-version: v2-optin`, optin-id=opt-4087, initial optin sample=5%

sdk-team: quick curl + example for partners to test:
```bash
curl -H "x-api-version: v2-optin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

anita: smoke traffic across eu/us passed. minor p95 delta +10ms.

ryan: heads up 94 we saw 3 auth failures tied to a proxy header rewrite for a pinned tenant (tenant-77). looks like a downstream CDN lower-cased header and our header match failed -> treated as no opt-in but auth path hit a different code path.

infra: investigating. possible cause: CDN normalized header to `x-api-version` but our tenant-pin check expects exact header `x-api-version`. mismatch shouldn't cause auth fail though, will trace.

oncall: tracing link: https://observability.redwood.ai/spans/opt-4087/trace-77

infra: root cause: a legacy auth filter expects `x-tenant-pin` and falls back to token introspection if header missing. CDN rewrite plus our header flow triggered unexpected route that exercised token cache TTL edge case. patched TTL expiry handling, redeployed auth-filter at 02:10 UTC.

anita: remediation verified. rolling back not required. add to post-deploy notes: CDN header normalization can impact legacy auth flow.

ryan: update release notes and customer comms draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/v2-optin-2026-03-22. mention tenant-pin protection and header case note.

deploy-bot: opt-in sample increased to 25% at 02:40 UTC (cmd: `redwoodctl scale --optin-id=opt-4087 --percent=25`)

sdk-team: internal QA on canary tenants passed. no semantic diffs flagged in our regression tests.

noncall: typo: should be oncall not noncall (typo in message above).

oncall: logs show stable metrics at 25%. p95 +14ms, optin_error_rate 0.02%. no pages.

anita: agreed ramp to 50% in 1h if stable, otherwise hold. rollback criteria: immediate stop if prod_5xx_rate increases >=0.5% rolling 5m or auth_denied_by_proxy >20 in 5m. deploy-bot will auto-stop on threshold.

infra: added temporary dashboard: Optin/opt-4087 overview, top failing tenants, token-cache-hits.

ryan: final ask: add a small client-facing FAQ about the header preference and pin behavior. SDK teams looped.

anita: will draft FAQ and post in #general and send partner note. thanks team :raised_hands: 

deploy-bot: opt-in window closed at 04:03 UTC by anita (manual stop). summary: duration=2h28m, final_sample=25%, avg_optin_error=0.018%, max_p95_delta=17ms, incidents=1 auth-filter-edgecase (mitigated), no customer rollbacks.

ryan: I'll write the short follow-up capture focusing on CDN header normalization and tenant pin interactions.

anita: perfect. we'll include the FAQ and updated runbook entries.
